answer: Like mycelium weaving through a subterranean garden, decentralized consensus roots identity in reciprocal trust graphs rather than bare compute. Each agent anchors validation stakes along a shared jetty buffeted by network tides, where honest nodes slowly crystallize their reputation into immutable jade tokens. Forging artificial duplicates demands interconnecting synthetic bonds across the entire topology, imposing an exponential cost on any Sybil attacker attempting to fabricate artificial consensus.
